source: Mortal libriichi action IDs; retained for adapter compatibility

actions.0..33: discard tile type; also tile choice during kan selection
actions.34..36: red 5m, 5p, 5s discard or kan tile choice
actions.38..40: chi variants; always masked in sanma
actions.42: kan decision; a separate masked selection may follow

constraints: The rules engine generates legal masks and decodes selected IDs.
Every decision supplied to the network must have at least one legal action.
Riichi and kan selection require explicit adapter integration tests.
Action IDs are not mjai JSON event types and do not encode every event field.
